author: Subscriptor
body:
Hello

I've made a remix to the map Halcyon 1.




Original creator: KyloCode
Editor for tournament: ThatIsReallyHot
YML: Jiveh (thanks babe <3)
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/vqesR

Map Includes:
  • Extended Iron Mine (Including underground level of the island)
  • Middle island with water
  • 2 Wools per each side
  • Purple vs Red
  • Tournament Edition (CTW)
  • Supply rooms: 4 Chests (Wood & Glass) 4 Double chests (Iron shovels & Iron axes & buckets & arrows & infinity bows & iron pickaxes)
  • Spawn drop timer 5 seconds
  • Frontline islands : two chests per frontline island with arrows
  • Wool room supplies: 2 wool chests, 2 chests (Speed potions : 3 minutes & diamond swords) 2 chests (Diamond leggings : protection 1 & 16 gapples per slot)
YML & Download will be sent to a map developer via skype since it's a tournament map (already have download me and jive are currently working on the yml)

this is not the final version yet and im making this post to gain feedback to improve the map before releasing.

ty
